MELE Per-Game Discord Presence - install notes

What it does
------------
Shows Discord presence while playing Mass Effect: Legendary Edition:
  - the exact game being played ("Mass Effect" / "Mass Effect 2" / "Mass Effect 3")
  - that game's official exe icon
  - a session playtime timer
Requires the Discord desktop app to be running while you play.
No other information is read from the game.

What you need installed first
-----------------------------
The MELE ASI loader (a bink2w64.dll proxy). If you use ME3Tweaks Mod Manager,
the loader is installed automatically via Mod Management -> ASI Mod Manager.
If you have ALOT or other native mods installed, the loader is already there.

Manual install
--------------
1. Copy LEPerGameDetection.asi into each game's Binaries\Win64 folder you
   want presence for:
     Mass Effect Legendary Edition\Game\ME1\Binaries\Win64\
     Mass Effect Legendary Edition\Game\ME2\Binaries\Win64\
     Mass Effect Legendary Edition\Game\ME3\Binaries\Win64\
2. (Optional) Copy LEPerGameDetection.ini next to the .asi file to override
   application IDs or the timer. Without an ini, compiled defaults apply.
3. Launch the game with Discord running. The per-game status appears under
   your name.

Uninstall
---------
Delete LEPerGameDetection.asi (and the .ini) from the game folder(s).

Troubleshooting
---------------
- Logs: %LOCALAPPDATA%\MELEDiscordRPC\
- Set debug=1 in the ini for an on-screen console while the game runs.
- If the name or icon look wrong: the Discord application names must be exactly
  "Mass Effect" / "Mass Effect 2" / "Mass Effect 3" and the art assets must be
  named le1 / le2 / le3 in each app's Art Assets.
